text.en: 1. This Notification is the Environmental Public Health (Declaration of DPWCS Area) Notification 2023.
2. The area described in the Schedule is declared a DPWCS area for the purpose of Part 3B of the Act, with effect from 22 November 2023.

THE SCHEDULE
Paragraph 2
Jurong Lake District DPWCS area
